main.description: Publish a version of a plugin to the caller's repo. Writes a software.release.manifest carrying the artifact, the changelog as a site.standard.document when one is given, the software.release.version, and the channel named by track, moved to the new version, in that order. A record is written only once everything it points at exists, so a failure part-way leaves no dangling reference. Calling again with the same input after such a failure finishes the release rather than refusing it.

name.description: The project's name, which is the record key of its software.release.project: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and interior hyphens.

version.description: A semver version without build metadata, with an optional lowercase prerelease, such as `1.2.0` or `1.2.0-beta.1`.

track.description: The channel to move to the new version.

artifact.description: The plugin. Every blob it references must already be uploaded to the caller's repo.

changelog.description: Release notes as CommonMark. The registry writes them to the caller's repo as a site.standard.document and links it from the version.

validateOnly.description: Check the input against every rule the registry applies, and write nothing. Still requires authentication.

valid.description: Always true; invalid input is an error, not a result.

resumed.description: True when the version already existed with this artifact, so this call only finished what an earlier one started.

manifest.description: The software.release.manifest. Absent when validateOnly was set.

version.description: The software.release.version. Absent when validateOnly was set.

channel.description: The software.release.channel. Absent when validateOnly was set.

changelog.description: The changelog's site.standard.document, when a changelog was given.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller's identity could not be determined, so there is no repo to write to.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry has no identity configured. An operator problem, not a caller's.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: The input breaks a rule the registry applies, so it would refuse the records. The message names the field.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: A record could not be written to the caller's repo. Records written before the failure stay, and the same call can be made again.

errors.name: ProjectMissing
errors.description: The caller has no project of that name, or the registry has not indexed its at.happyproto.registry.project record. Call putProject first.

errors.name: VersionExists
errors.description: That version is already published with a different artifact. A version never changes once published; publish a new one.
